adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then uses them directly in `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no clamping/validation. This allows arbitrarily large `limit` (potentially loading/serializing huge member lists) and permits negative values (e.g. `limit=-1`, `offset=-5`) which ActiveRecord may pass through to PostgreSQL and raise an error (500) rather than a controlled 4xx. The previous code path constrained this behavior to automatic groups and defaulted offset, but the new code applies it generally and still lacks bounds.
